newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month, nine-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down and 12-month yields rose from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills slipped to 22.81 percent from 23.34 percent, six-month bills edged down to 24.51 percent from 25.40 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 28.62 percent from 28.91 percent and 12-month bills firmed to 32.28 percent from 32.14 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 8.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.57 million UAH 4.72 million UAH
The central bank sold 80,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 350 were competitive and 79,650 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 16.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 14.00 million UAH 9.00 million UAH
Amount sold 14.00 million UAH 9.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.47 million UAH 7.99 million UAH
The central bank sold 140,000 T-bills, the bank statement said. Of those, 1,000 were competitive and 139,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 16.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 24.00 million UAH
Amount sold 26.51 million UAH 13.09 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.83 million UAH 10.77 million UAH
The central bank sold 265,063 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 146,272 were competitive and 118,791 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 16.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 48.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 30.03 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.72 million UAH 23.48 million UAH
The central bank sold 300,314 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 239,857 were competitive and 60,457 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 16.
